title: Synthetic Speech Pause Variability Positive Study
abstract: A fictional cohort reports higher speech pause variability in participants labelled with MCI.
main_knowledge_claim: Higher speech pause variability was associated with MCI in the synthetic cohort.

title: Synthetic Speech Pause Variability Opposing Study
abstract: A matched fictional cohort reports lower speech pause variability in participants labelled with MCI.
main_knowledge_claim: Lower speech pause variability was associated with MCI in a matched synthetic cohort.

title: Synthetic Speech Pause Variability Null Study
abstract: A fictional cohort reports no association between speech pause variability and MCI labels.
main_knowledge_claim: Speech pause variability was not associated with MCI in the synthetic cohort.

title: Synthetic Imaging Transfer Study
abstract: A fictional multimodal model improves internal classification but not external-cohort performance.
main_knowledge_claim: Imaging improved internal classification but did not transfer to the external synthetic cohort.

title: Synthetic Late-Stage Dementia Context Study
abstract: A fictional secondary analysis concerns established dementia and is only adjacent to early detection.

title: Synthetic Treatment Response Optimization Study
abstract: A fictional study optimizes treatment response and does not perform detection or screening.
main_knowledge_claim: Treatment response improved in the fictional intervention group.

title: Synthetic Ambiguous Multimodal Screening Study
abstract: A fictional abstract mixes screening and disease monitoring without a resolvable primary task.
main_knowledge_claim: The fictional report contains mixed screening and monitoring results.

title: Synthetic Insufficiently Reported Cognitive Signal Study
abstract: A fictional abstract lacks enough detail to determine population method or early-detection relevance.
main_knowledge_claim: The fictional report does not provide enough information for a knowledge claim.
